category_mapping.classification: COICOP 2018 as used in the Household Budget Survey 2022

Groceries.note: Supermarket basket: food and non-alcoholic drinks (01), alcohol and tobacco (02), non-durable household goods such as detergents (05.6.1), personal care products (13.1.2).

Restaurants.note: Restaurants, cafes, canteens (11.1). Accommodation (11.2) is under Travel.

Transportation.note: Running a vehicle (fuel, parts, service, parking, tolls, inspections/licences) and local/long-distance rail, bus, taxi, combined tickets. Excludes buying a vehicle (07.1), motor insurance (12.1.4), flights and ferries (Travel).

Utilities.note: Water, refuse, sewage, other dwelling services n.e.c., electricity/gas/heating fuels (04.5), phone/internet/streaming subscriptions (08.3). Insurance is NOT included.

Entertainment.note: Recreational and sporting services, games of chance, cinemas/theatres/museums and other cultural services, hire of recreational gear (09.4 excl. vets, 09.6).

Health.note: All of division 06: medicines, medical products, doctor, dentist, hospital fees.

Home & Tech.note: Furniture, household textiles, appliances, tableware, tools (05.1-05.5), DIY materials for the dwelling (04.3.1), phones/computers/TV/audio equipment (08.1), software (08.2), cameras (09.1.1), electric personal-care appliances (13.1.1).

Housing.note: Cash housing payments: actual rents (04.1), maintenance charges of housing companies / hoitovastike (04.4.4.1), interest on housing loans (04.6.3). Excludes imputed rent (04.2) and loan principal (not consumption, not in the survey).

Lifestyle.note: Clothing and footwear (03), games/toys/hobby and sports goods (09.2), musical instruments and media (09.5), books/newspapers/stationery (09.7), jewellery, watches, bags and other personal effects (13.2).

Travel.note: Flights (07.3.3), ferries (07.3.4), car hire (07.2.4.4), package holidays (09.8), accommodation (11.2). Spending abroad (77) is not allocated to categories by the survey and is excluded here.
